label: India-listed ETFs & Funds — Domestic, Global & Alternatives

groups.name: Broad Market Index ETFs
groups.blurb: ETFs tracking India's flagship indices — Nifty 50 and Nifty Next 50. The most liquid instruments for core equity allocation.

groups.name: Bank & Financial ETFs
groups.blurb: ETFs tracking banking and financial services indices — the heaviest-weighted sectors in Nifty.

groups.name: Sector & Thematic ETFs
groups.blurb: Targeted exposure to specific sectors — IT, pharma, infrastructure, PSU enterprises, consumption, and more.

groups.name: Mid & Small Cap ETFs
groups.blurb: ETFs tracking mid-cap and small-cap indices — higher growth potential with higher volatility.

groups.name: Smart Beta & Factor ETFs
groups.blurb: Factor-based ETFs — quality, value, low volatility, dividend yield. Systematic strategies that tilt towards proven return drivers.

groups.name: US & International Equity
groups.blurb: India-listed ETFs and Fund-of-Funds tracking US & global indices — Nasdaq 100, S&P 500, NYSE FANG+, Hang Seng. Denominated in INR.

groups.name: Debt & Bond ETFs
groups.blurb: Government securities, PSU bonds, and target-maturity bond ETFs. Use for fixed-income allocation, duration management, or tactical hedging when rates peak.

groups.name: Gold & Silver ETFs
groups.blurb: Physical-backed precious metal ETFs listed on NSE. Core allocation of 5–10% helps offset equity drawdowns and INR weakness.

groups.name: Hedging & Safe-Haven ETFs
groups.blurb: NSE-listed instruments for hedging equity exposure. Indian exchanges don't offer inverse equity ETFs, so the practical toolkit is gold, silver, liquid funds and G-Sec bond ETFs — assets that historically hold value or rise when Nifty falls.
